brief: Best bet: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps — a curated goldmine of 100+ working AI agent/RAG apps; ship a vertical SaaS wrapper (e.g., legal or healthcare) this week to capture early demand.
Breakout timing: This repo is trending now; the window to fork, niche-down, and launch is 2-4 weeks before copycats saturate the space.
Action: Pick 3 top apps (e.g., customer-support agent, document Q&A), bundle them into a single 'AI toolkit' subscription, price at $49/mo.
Risk check: Repo is a list, not a product—your moat is UX, integrations, and support, not the code itself.
Secondary play: Build a 'repo-to-product' pipeline that auto-deploys any app from this list to a cloud instance, selling setup as a service.

items.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.one_liner: Curated 100+ open-source AI agents and RAG apps.
items.pain_point: Developers waste time hunting for proven AI agent patterns; enterprises need ready-made automation blueprints.
app_ideas: Agent Playground: A web UI to browse, configure, and deploy these agents with one-click API keys
Vertical RAG Pack: Pre-built RAG templates for legal/medical docs with compliance filters
Agent-to-API Bridge: Convert any agent from the list into a REST endpoint with auth and rate limiting
items.why_now: Star momentum (0.53% weekly) signals peak interest; enterprises are adopting agents but lack curated, deployable templates.
